name: Easy Booking Calendar for WooCommerce
author: Devnet

sections.description:
Easy Booking Calendar for WooCommerce adds date-based bookings to your product pages. Customers select their dates, and the plugin calculates the booking price using your product price and the number of days or nights.

Use it for room stays, equipment rentals, or other products booked by date. Configure your calendar under Products > Booking Calendar, then enable Bookable on each product you want to offer for booking.

Each booking appears as one line item, with its dates and duration shown separately from quantity. Dates are reserved when an order reaches Processing or Completed and released when that order is cancelled, unless double bookings are enabled.

Free features

  • Add a booking calendar to your products.
  • Calculate prices by day or night.
  • Choose available dates and how far ahead customers can book.
  • Block booked dates, or allow multiple bookings on the same dates.
  • View booked dates and their orders in the product editor.
  • Show booking dates and duration in the cart, checkout, and orders.
  • Choose calendar colors, themes, language, and date format.
  • Show the calendar only to logged-in customers if needed.
  • Customize the calendar heading and booking button text.

Easy Booking Calendar Pro

Need weekend prices or different available dates for each product? The paid Pro version adds:

  • Raise or lower prices by a fixed amount for selected dates or date ranges.
  • Set different prices for weekends or other weekdays.
  • Drag pricing rules to choose which takes priority.
  • Set available dates separately for each product.
  • Reopen individual booked dates without cancelling the whole booking.
  • Show customers their booking total before adding to cart.
  • Show a price breakdown when booked dates have different prices.
  • Allow single-date bookings and choose Monday or Sunday as the start of the week.

For example, charge more on summer weekends or offer a lower price on quieter dates.

Pro is optional; the free version supports date-range bookings without a paid license.

sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Easy Booking Calendar.
  3. Install and activate the Easy Booking Calendar plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the easy-booking-calendar folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Go to Plugins and activate the Easy Booking Calendar plugin.

After Activation

  1. Navigate to Products > Booking Calendar to configure the plugin.
  2. Once set up, enable the calendar on the desired product page.
sections.faq:
How do I enable the calendar for a product?

After setting up the plugin, go to the product page, and enable the booking calendar in the product settings. You’ll find the Bookable checkbox right after the product type dropdown.

When are dates considered booked?

Dates are reserved when an order reaches Processing or Completed. Cancelling the order releases its booked dates. If double bookings are enabled, overlapping bookings are allowed.

How are days, nights, and quantity calculated?

January 1-3 is two nights in night-based mode or three days in day-based mode. Each booking uses a quantity of one; its duration determines the booking price rather than the WooCommerce quantity field.

Can I charge different prices on weekends or specific dates?

Yes, with Pro. Add a fixed increase or decrease for individual dates, or choose a date range and restrict it to selected weekdays. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom, and only the first matching rule applies to each date.

Can I release one date from a booking?

Pro lets you click a booked date in the product editor to restore its availability. This changes availability only; it does not shorten the original order or issue a refund. Handle any order adjustments separately in WooCommerce.

How do I translate the calendar heading and button text?

Leave the text fields empty to use the plugin’s translatable defaults, which can be translated with tools such as Loco Translate. Entered custom text overrides those defaults. Existing multilingual settings and intentionally hidden headings are preserved for compatibility. Calendar month and weekday language is controlled separately by the calendar locale setting.

Should I set my bookable product as virtual?

Yes, it’s recommended to set your bookable product as Virtual to avoid unnecessary shipping calculations, as bookings typically don’t require physical delivery.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

2026-09-11

  • Fix: Order emails consistently display readable booking metadata labels
  • Fix: Product availability overrides no longer inherit conflicting global future-date limits
  • Add: Booked dates are marked in the product editor calendar
  • Add: Booking price breakdowns in the cart, checkout, orders, and order emails
  • Update: Bookings now use one booking per line item instead of representing booking duration as quantity
  • Update: Calendars open at the first available allowed date when using selected-date availability
  • Update: Removed the Multilingual checkbox – empty text fields use translated defaults while custom text remains an override
  • Compatibility: Preserve existing multilingual settings, custom text, and intentionally hidden calendar headings
  • Update: Removed the General settings tab and moved Show only for logged in users to Calendar, preserving existing settings
  • Update: Updated Freemius SDK to the latest version
  • Compatibility: WooCommerce tested up to 11.1

Earlier release notes are available in changelog.txt, included with the plugin.
